notes.title: Game update/bugfix
notes.content:
Another small batch of bugfixes and changes:
[list]
[*] Corrected a few more spelling errors
[*] Fixed the 'Downtrodden' achievement; This achievement slipped through the cracks of our testers, not triggering when it should.
[*] Changed how the 'Lest' Achievement is unlocked. Previously, you could lock yourself out of this achievement on a single playthrough by defeating Petyr 4 times. Now, you can also unlock it by meeting him at cragmoth after defeating him that many times.
[/list]
As always, thank you to the players discussing and reporting these bugs!
Ibe

notes.title: Steam deck compatibility
notes.content:
If you're wondering how compatible [i]Verses of Enchantment[/i] is with the Steam deck before Steam does their own tests, here's a rundown:
[list]
[*] The game runs natively on linux and performs well
[*] The game has [b]full controller support[/b]
[*] The game has an alternative font to improve legibility
[/list]
[b]But...[/b]
[list]
[*] The game's UI & text was originally designed for larger screens, so the game does not read that well on the Steam deck
[/list]
So in short; The game is [b]playable[/b] on the Steam deck, but I recommend a PC for a more comfortable experience.

Cheers
Ibe

tags.feature: The game has [b]full controller support[/b]
The game has an alternative font to improve legibility

notes.title: Demo update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Here's a quick update to the demo:

[list]
[*] Changed the mouse cursor to something more thematic
[*] Added accessibility options for fonts, and colorblindness, among others
[*] Incompatible save data is now moved to a separate folder instead of being deleted
[/list]

There's been reports that the game crashes when entering the campaign mode; this is caused by incompatible save files from previous versions. Normally, these should be compatible, but as a temporary workaround, the game will put saves from previous versions in [i]C:\Users\<your_username>\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Verses of Enchantment\old\[/i] and create a new one.

So if you're wondering where your save data went and would like to transfer your data, please send your save file to [i]support@nachtvlam.be[/i] so I can see where the problem lies and push an update that allows for these saves to be patched.

Cheers
Ibe

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

While I'm working on finishing the content for the full version of the game, I'm updating the demo with a host of bugfixes and feature updates:

Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*] Improved the generated poetry to be less repetitive
[*] Improved poetry content tagging and detection
[*] Added collectable card sleeves
[*] Reduced the filesize by compressing large assets
[*] Sped up loading times when finishing duels on the campaign map
[*] Updated the tutorial on poetry related card effects
[*] Fixed some map scrolling and panning bugs
[*] Adjusted the campaign map ambient sfx
[*] Added a deck editor search box to filter collected cards
[*] Fixed wizard chatlog related bugs
[*] Updated and added some wizard dialogues
[*] Implemented multi-threaded save buffers to avoid lag spikes when saving data to disk
[*] Changed the trading interface to be clearer
[*] Trading prices are now dependent on player supply and demand
[*] Trading merchants now have a maximum stock and budget
[*] Wizards now have a fixed set of cards you can earn when beating them
[*] Wizards can now refuse duels, give gold or rations depending on the conversation
[*] Added a pretty card glittering effect for unlearned or newly learned cards
[*] Optimized card interactions to avoid lag spikes on low end machines
[*] Updated some music tracks with revised versions by Rupert Cole
[/list]
Cheers
Ibe
